stories.caption:
☕ Coffee Table Workshop is on! ✨

A lovely couple came together 
for a creative date,
putting the daily little things aside
and simply enjoying quality time
with each other. ❤️

And since it happened to be the wife’s birthday… 🎂
Teacher had to make it a little extra special! 🎁🎁🎁🎁

A complimentary coaster workshop 
as a birthday gift. 🎁
When Teacher gives, 
she gives generously! 😆💕

They discussed, teased, laughed, 
and worked together,
turning a beautiful coffee table into
a beautiful memory they can take home. 🪵✨

Here’s to more beautiful moments,
more laughter, 
and more things created together. ✨

茶几课堂，开课咯～✨

夫妻俩相约来上课，
把生活里的琐碎暂时放一旁，
一起慢下来，好好陪伴彼此，
用心完成这一张独一无二的漂亮茶几。🪵✨

恰逢太太生日🎂
老师当然要有点表示～
特别附送 杯垫课程 🎁🎁🎁🎁🎁
老师送礼，向来一点都不手软！😆

过程中有商量、有调侃，
还有满满的笑声与欢乐～
原来，最美的作品，
不只是成品，而是一起完成它的过程。❤️

愿你们把这份专属的回忆，
连同亲手完成的茶几，
一起带回家，继续幸福地使用下去。💕

stories.caption:
What does it feel like to handcraft a birthday gift for a friend? 🎁💙

It's sincerity.
It's joy.
It's excitement.
And it's the satisfaction of creating something truly meaningful.

This isn't just a gift,
it's a one-of-a-kind piece, 
made especially for someone you care about.

Every step of the process is enjoyable,
filled with thought, care, and creativity.

And when it's finished,
the result often exceeds our expectations.

The powerful ocean waves she envisioned came to life beautifully,
while the simple composition made the whole piece feel balanced and complete.

A gift made by hand carries something no store can offer~
your time, your heart, and your love. 🌊✨

亲手为朋友制作一份生日礼物，
是一种什么样的感觉？🎁💙

是满满的诚意，
是创作的快乐，
是送礼前的期待，
更是完成后的满足。

这不仅是一份礼物，
更是一份独一无二、
专属于对方的心意。

整个创作过程都充满享受，
每一步都倾注了用心，
而完成的那一刻，
成品甚至超乎了我们的想象。

她期待的澎湃海浪，
在作品中完美呈现。
构图简约，却层次丰富，
每一道浪花，都诉说着祝福。

这样的礼物，因为亲手制作，
所以更有温度，也更值得珍藏。 🌊✨
